mapper.select: select delivery_id from picking_wave as pw left join picking_wave_detail as pwd on pw.id = pwd.main_id and is_delete = false where pw.status = #{status}

SELECT pwd.main_id, pwd.basket_no, pwd.delivery_id, pd.ID, pd.sku_id, pd.sku_no, pd.picked_qty, pd.allocated_qty FROM picking_wave_detail AS pwd LEFT JOIN so_b2c_delivery_detail AS sbdd ON sbdd.is_deleted = FALSE AND sbdd.main_id = pwd.delivery_id LEFT JOIN picking_detail AS pd ON pd.is_deleted = FALSE AND pd.source_detail_id = sbdd.ID
